scenarios.title: A｜房间没有打扫干净
scenarios.setting: 在“卫生问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“房间没有打扫干净”。

turns.prompt: 你想反映房间清洁不到位，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I don’t think my room was cleaned properly.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I don’t think my room was cleaned properly.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: My room doesn’t seem to have been cleaned.

feedback.naturalExpression: My room doesn’t seem to have been cleaned.
feedback.explanation: “have been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

choices.text: I just checked in, and the room is still dirty.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just checked in, and the room is still dirty.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: There are used towels and trash in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: There are used towels and trash in the room.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: My room didn’t clean well.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I don’t think my room was cleaned properly.
feedback.explanation: 房间是被清洁的对象，应说“wasn’t cleaned properly”；不是房间自己“didn’t clean”。

turns.text: I’m very sorry about that. What seems to have been missed?

turns.prompt: 关于「卫生问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: There’s still trash in the bin.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s still trash in the bin.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: The floor hasn’t been cleaned.

feedback.naturalExpression: The floor hasn’t been cleaned.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: There are used towels in the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: There are used towels in the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: It looks like the previous guest’s things haven’t been cleared away.

feedback.naturalExpression: It looks like the previous guest’s things haven’t been cleared away.
feedback.explanation: “looks like”根据眼前迹象作判断，给结论留有一点余地。

turns.text: I apologize. We’ll send housekeeping up immediately.

turns.prompt: 你想说明日期、时长或时间上的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. Could they clean the room as soon as possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could they clean the room as soon as possible?
feedback.explanation: “as soon as possible”表示尽快，说明事情紧急，但没有指定一个确定时点。

choices.text: Would it be possible to move me to a clean room instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to move me to a clean room instead?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Okay. About how long will it take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. About how long will it take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

scenarios.title: B｜床单 / 浴室不干净
scenarios.setting: 在“卫生问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“床单 / 浴室不干净”。

turns.prompt: 你想提出更换不干净床品的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I think the sheets on my bed need to be changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think the sheets on my bed need to be changed.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: There are stains on the bedsheets.

feedback.naturalExpression: There are stains on the bedsheets.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: The bathroom wasn’t cleaned properly.

feedback.naturalExpression: The bathroom wasn’t cleaned properly.
feedback.explanation: “wasn’t cleaned”用被动形式说明清洁没有完成，把问题落在服务结果上。

choices.text: There are hairs in the shower.**

feedback.naturalExpression: There are hairs in the shower.**
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: My bedsheet is not clean enough.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think the sheets on my bed need to be changed.
feedback.explanation: 这句能说明床单不干净；如果目的是请求处理，进一步说希望更换，工作人员更好接着办理。

turns.text: I’m very sorry. Would you like housekeeping to come up now?

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店重新处理房间不干净的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, could someone change the sheets, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, could someone change the sheets, please?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Yes. Could someone clean the bathroom again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Could someone clean the bathroom again?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if someone could take care of it now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if someone could take care of it now.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

turns.text: Absolutely. We’ll send someone up right away.

turns.prompt: 关于「卫生问题」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’ll be in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’ll be in the room.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great, thank you for taking care of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for taking care of it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: C｜房间有异味
scenarios.setting: 在“卫生问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“房间有异味”。

turns.prompt: 关于「卫生问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, there’s a strange smell in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a strange smell in my room.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: My room has a strong unpleasant smell.

feedback.naturalExpression: My room has a strong unpleasant smell.
feedback.explanation: “unpleasant smell”明确说明有异味，后续可补充位置或气味特征。

choices.text: There’s a strong smell of smoke in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a strong smell of smoke in the room.
feedback.explanation: “smell of smoke”明确是烟味，比泛泛说气味不好更便于处理。

choices.text: The bathroom smells really bad.

feedback.naturalExpression: The bathroom smells really bad.
feedback.explanation: “smells really bad”明确说明有异味，后续可补充位置或气味特征。

choices.text: My room has a bad smelling.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a strange smell in my room.
feedback.explanation: 气味名词是“smell”，不是“a smelling”；可说“There’s a bad smell in my room”。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. Do you know where the smell is coming from?

turns.prompt: 你想说明异味可能来自哪里，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m not sure. It seems to be coming from the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. It seems to be coming from the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: No, I noticed it as soon as I entered the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I noticed it as soon as I entered the room.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: I think it’s coming from the air conditioner.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s coming from the air conditioner.
feedback.explanation: “air conditioner”指空调设备，通常作为可数名词。

choices.text: I’m not sure, but it’s quite strong.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure, but it’s quite strong.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.text: We can send someone up to check it.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. If it can’t be fixed, could I change rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. If it can’t be fixed, could I change rooms?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Yes, please. The smell is quite uncomfortable.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please. The smell is quite uncomfortable.
feedback.explanation: “uncomfortable”指不舒服或不自在，描述的是自己的感受。

choices.text: Great. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

scenarios.title: D｜发现虫子
scenarios.setting: 在“卫生问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“发现虫子”。

turns.prompt: 关于「卫生问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I found some insects in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I found some insects in my room.
feedback.explanation: “insects”指昆虫；报告位置和数量能帮助工作人员安排处理。

choices.text: There are bugs in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: There are bugs in my room.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: I just found several insects in the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just found several insects in the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: “insects”指昆虫；报告位置和数量能帮助工作人员安排处理。

choices.text: I found a bug near the bed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I found a bug near the bed.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: My room has many bugs inside.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I found some insects in my room.
feedback.explanation: 这句可以理解，“bugs”也是常见口语；补充在哪里发现，会比只说很多虫子更有助于检查。

turns.text: I’m very sorry to hear that. Where did you see them?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认位置或去向，你会怎样说清楚地点？

choices.text: I saw them in the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: I saw them in the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: There were a few near the sink.

feedback.naturalExpression: There were a few near the sink.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: I found one on the bed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I found one on the bed.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I’m not sure where they’re coming from.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure where they’re coming from.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.text: I apologize. We’ll have someone inspect the room immediately.

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I’d prefer to change rooms, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer to change rooms, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Could you move me to another room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move me to another room?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d rather not stay in this room tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not stay in this room tonight.
feedback.explanation: “stay in”指待在家、不外出，适合聊休闲偏好。

choices.text: Can you make sure the new room doesn’t have the same problem?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you make sure the new room doesn’t have the same problem?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.text: Of course. Let me see what other rooms are available.
